title:
Listens to 'FORM_SUBMIT' on 'Reliability.AddToCaseMultiStepForm'.
When {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s are being added to case from , this epic
validates to ensure all the required fields in all the nested forms are filled.
If it's not valid, opens 'Reliability.ModalBanner', informing user to fill all the required fields.
If it's valid, it triggers {@link UiSdlEpicAddToCase} && {@link UiSdlEpicSubmitAlertAndModelFeedback}.
name: ValidateAddAlertsToCaseFormFieldsEpic
